name: Hontanar (Spain)
description: White field with a green triangle at the hoist whose apex reaches the centre of the fly.
history: The heraldic arms were officially approved on 10 August 1998 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 21 August 1998; the design of the municipal flag, approved at the same time as the arms, is a rectangular flag of proportions 2:3, white, with a green triangle whose base occupies the hoist edge and whose apex is at the centre of the fly.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre of the fly
